title: Songbook and Postcard
author: Noor Vasquez
blurb: Ines Zhou, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
